messages:
maria (AE): FYI — Frostline just dropped an RFI + a 35‑page security questionnaire. They want a POC cost breakdown, answers for HSM/SSO, and confirmation of data residency. Demo scheduled Tue next week. Can SE + security + ops help put together a response and POC quote?

doc-bot: maria uploaded file 'frostline-rfi-2026.pdf' -> https://files.redwood.internal/rfIs/frostline-rfi-2026.pdf :file_folder:

chad (SE): I can own the POC infra. Quick clarifying Qs: are they explicitly asking for Dedicated capacity in VPC or are they open to Hosted+Private peering? Also need target QPS, avg token length, and latency SLOs to size.

maria (AE): they requested Dedicated with VPC (see p.4). Target is ~15 req/s, 1000 tokens avg, 95th latency <500ms.

jules (SalesOps): Draft POC pricing options, please review and flag changes:

```
POC pricing (ballpark)
- Trial Lite (2w) : $4,500 - shared infra, basic support
- Standard POC (4w): $12,000 - single dedicated node, monitoring + 8/5 SE support
- Enterprise POC (6w): $28,000 - reserved capacity, on‑prem connector, security review support
Notes: pricing excludes HSM appliance + cross‑connect fees.
```

chad (SE): That looks fine. For their latency SLO we'll recommend an A100x4 dedicated pool or equivalent (autoscale burst). I'll draft an infra diagram and include required IP allowlist / peering steps.

lex (Security): Re: questionnaire — two explicit blockers: they require FIPS 140‑2 HSM and call out FedRAMP moderate controls. We do not have FedRAMP. We CAN support customer‑managed HSM via BYOK + KMS integration and provide SOC2 Type II artifacts. I'll mark FedRAMP as "timeline/roadmap" item and provide mitigations.

amy (Legal): @maria @lex — we can’t promise FedRAMP. Recommend offering: (1) a written remediation timeline with milestones, (2) provisional acceptance criteria for POC that don’t hinge on FedRAMP, and (3) a contract credit if FedRAMP commitment misses the milestone. I’ll draft clause.

maria (AE): perfect. Amy, can you post the paragraph by EOD Thu? Customer expects an initial RFI reply by Friday.

chad (SE): infra checklist snippet for the response:

```
- VPC peering CIDRs: <customer-vpc-cidr>
- Ports: 443, 22 (ops), 1976 (realtime)
- Expected certs: mTLS for peering, customer-provided root CA
- HSM: HSM endpoint + serial for BYOK setup (if needed)
```

lex (Security): I'll attach redlined answers to the security questionnaire and highlight items needing engineering/legal follow-up (FedRAMP, FIPS cert). Will also include SOC2 artifacts and pen test summary.

jules (SalesOps): I'll assemble SOW + SOW cost table and include an option line for HSM appliance pass‑through. Tentative SOW draft by Fri noon.

amy (Legal): Drafted language — attaching snippet: "Redwood will provide a documented FedRAMP attainment plan and use commercially reasonable efforts to achieve relevant controls. For the POC, both parties agree on an alternative acceptance criteria that does not require FedRAMP. Failure to achieve FedRAMP by the milestone will trigger the agreed remediation credits." Posting to thread.

maria (AE): Awesome — next steps: 1) Chad: infra diagram + short runbook (EOD Thu) 2) Lex: questionnaire answers + artifacts (Thu EOD) 3) Jules: SOW draft + pricing table (Fri AM) 4) Amy: legal clause (Thu EOD). I’ll consolidate and send the initial RFI reply to Frostline Friday afternoon.

chad (SE): noted — will create a Jira ticket and link once done.

doc-bot: jira issue RED-4123 created: "POC for Frostline — infra + security questionnaire" -> https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/RED-4123

maria (AE): thanks team :thumbsup: I'll loop in the customer with a short timeline and proposed SOW once all artifacts are in.
